pricing_assumptions.title: ⚠️ Pricing Assumptions & Limitations
pricing_assumptions.model_pricing: Costs use model-specific pricing when available. If you changed models in Settings, ensure environment variables match (PHI4_COST_PER_1K_INPUT/OUTPUT).
pricing_assumptions.reprocessing: Reprocessing emails accumulates new costs but overwrites old telemetry. Historical spending is not preserved per email.
pricing_assumptions.adversarial: Adversarial comparison costs are NOT tracked. Running dual-model comparisons doubles token usage but only primary model costs appear here.
pricing_assumptions.env_override: For accurate pricing, update environment variables to match your deployed models or consult Azure Cost Management for authoritative data.

costs.model_comparison_desc: Projected classification-only LLM cost per 10K emails based on actual avg token usage. Does not include entity extraction, PII, or adversarial calls.

costs.projection_ai_no_data: No AI usage cost data yet (0 emails with usage). Process at least one document to compute the variable estimate.

usage.title: How to Use
usage.step1_desc: The main dashboard provides a real-time view of incoming emails.
usage.step1_li1: Status Codes: Green (Processed), Amber (Review Required), Red (Error).
usage.step1_li2: Scoring: Confidence scores (0-100%) indicate how certain the AI is.
usage.step1_li3: Indicators: Look for badges indicating Sensitive Data or Images.
usage.step2_desc: Click 'Open Details' on any email to enter the review mode.
usage.step2_li1: View the original PDF and the extracted Markdown side-by-side.
usage.step2_li2: See the AI Analysis section for reasoning.
usage.step2_li3: Correct categories if the AI is wrong. Provide a reason to help future Fine-Tuning.
usage.step3_desc: Use the Upload tab to manually ingest PDF files for testing. In production, files arrive automatically via Email/Blob Storage.
usage.step4_desc: Customize the behavior of the engine in the Settings tab.
usage.step4_li1: Categories: Define exact intent names. Changes apply immediately.
usage.step4_li2: Processing Strategy: Switch between Standard, Reasoning, or Vision modes.

ai.title: Global Complexity & Reasoning
ai.desc: The system determines complexity based on:
ai.li1: Multi-Intent: Emails requesting multiple distinct actions (e.g., 'Change address AND send statement').
ai.li2: Ambiguity: Vague wording requiring inference or context from attachments.
ai.li3: Strategy: Using the 'Reasoning' strategy (Settings) forces the AI to output a justification before classifying, improving accuracy on complex cases.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Safety (PII)
privacy.desc: GDPR-compliant Personal Identifiable Information (PII) management with configurable detection and anonymization:
privacy.detection_desc: The AI flags emails containing sensitive data. Enable in Settings > Processing > Email Preprocessing.
privacy.detection_li1: LLM-based: Contextual understanding using your chosen model — extracts names, emails, phones, addresses, contract IDs, and dates.
privacy.detection_li2: Azure AI Language: Native service with 40+ predefined PII categories (~€0.001/email).
privacy.detection_li3: Hybrid: Runs both methods in parallel and merges results for maximum accuracy.
privacy.detection_li4: Configurable Model: PII detection can reuse your classification model (Auto) or use a dedicated deployment (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-5-nano, etc.).
privacy.detection_categories: Detected categories: names, emails, phones, addresses, contract/policy numbers, dates, and other identifiers (SSN, passport, IBAN).
privacy.anonymization_desc: When exporting JSONL data for fine-tuning, the system automatically scrubs all PII using a dedicated anonymizer model:
privacy.anonymization_li1: Names, emails, and dates are replaced with generic placeholders ([Name], [Email], [Date]).
privacy.anonymization_li2: Financial figures, addresses, and reference numbers are masked.
privacy.anonymization_li3: Markdown structure (headers, links, tables) is fully preserved.
privacy.settings_hint: Configure PII detection method and model in Settings > Processing > Email Preprocessing.

vision.title: Smart Vision (Mistral Document AI)
vision.desc: The system leverages Mistral's advanced Layout Analysis to intelligently handle visual content.
vision.standard_desc: The pipeline is 'Content Aware': Text documents are OCR'd normally. However, if visual elements (photos, diagrams) are detected *inside* the document, they are automatically captioned by the Vision model.
vision.vision_desc: The system intelligently distinguishes between a 'scanned page' (treated as text source) and 'meaningful images' (e.g. car crash photos). Redundant descriptions of the page itself are suppressed. Note: Mistral annotations are limited to 8 pages; beyond that, GPT-4o-mini provides fallback descriptions.

architecture.title: System Architecture
architecture.desc_html: The ClassyMail system leverages Azure Container Apps to host two distinct microservices: the FastAPI Backend (handling API requests) and the Background Worker (processing long-running tasks asynchronously). This decoupling allows independent scaling: the API scales on HTTP traffic, while the Worker scales based on Service Bus queue depth.
